SR-001.evidence: tests/kernel_facts/tests/kernel_facts.rs::main (sandbox precheck); run under sandbox-exec recorded in quickstart.md scenario 3
SR-001.justification: Ran the suite under sandbox-exec; header showed sandboxed yes and all 16 enforcement facts failed with the outside-sandbox message, none skipped or passed.

SR-002.justification: A failed control run becomes SetupFailed, a wrong errno fails with expected errno=1 and the observed errno=13, and a crashed step is never judged; the unexpected-errno path was also observed in real runs.

SR-003.justification: After setsid the child cannot open /dev/tty (ENXIO) before it opens its own pty, so the inherited terminal is out of reach; the byte is a constant 'k' with no newline.

SR-004.evidence: tests/kernel_facts/src/bin/kf-probe/macos.rs SETUID_ARGV and nested(); main.rs::scratch_arg; grep for shells and fork in the runner and probe found none
SR-004.justification: Every exec uses an absolute constant path or current_exe with constant step names and validated scratch paths; sudo runs with -n, stdin /dev/null and a 10 s deadline, and completed in 0.03 s.

SR-005.justification: Exclusive directory and file creation both fail on a planted symlink and leave its target unchanged; scratch dirs are 0700 and removed; no procage-kf-* remained after full runs.

SR-006.evidence: tests/kernel_facts/tests/kernel_facts.rs::m17 (KF-M17 observes exit=signal:6 in a child; later facts KF-M18…M28 ran in the same run)
SR-006.justification: The 20,000-rule abort is recorded as an observation and the suite continued to completion in every full run.

SR-007.justification: A 30 s child under a 200 ms timeout is killed and reported as Exit::Timeout well within 5 s; the bisection runs only with PROCAGE_KF_BISECT=1.

SR-008.evidence: tests/kernel_facts/tests/kernel_facts.rs (steps only via run_step/Command); the only fork is tests/kernel_facts/src/sys/macos.rs::PreparedExec::spawn, exercised by KF-M18
SR-008.justification: The runner has no pre_exec or fork. The one fork window issues dup2, __mac_syscall, execve and _exit on memory prepared before fork, and passed 200/200 under contention.

SR-009.justification: An unknown symbol is returned by name; every real symbol resolves. Lints confine unsafe to sys, with SAFETY comments enforced by clippy.

SR-010.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:9 (permissions contents read), :27/:35 (40-hex SHA pins), persist-credentials false on every checkout
SR-010.justification: Every uses reference is pinned to a full commit SHA, the token is read-only, and no secrets are referenced.

SR-011.evidence: justfile deny recipe (cargo deny --workspace check); quickstart.md scenario 9 (GPL path dependency caught)
SR-011.justification: An injected GPL-3.0 path dependency failed the gate after the --workspace fix; the lockfile is in the tree and the deny config allows crates.io only.

SR-012.evidence: tests/kernel_facts/tests/kernel_facts.rs::header; target/kernel-facts/report-*.txt; question finding doc comments on m23/m25/m26 and the compile-abort bracket constants
SR-012.justification: Every run printed OS build or kernel, arch, UTC date and tier. Each finding records date, build, method and whether it is measured or inferred.

SR-013.justification: Both recipes run as user 65534, mount the source read-only, and use neither --privileged nor host networking; both ran successfully.

SR-014.evidence: tests/kernel_facts/src/lib.rs::emit (asserts the observation alphabet) and ::tests::observations; KF-M19 reports fd_bytes=16, never contents
SR-014.justification: Observations are restricted to numbers, flags and tokens by construction. The inherited-fd fact reports the byte count only.

SR-015.justification: An injected planning path in src/lib.rs failed the gate, and the clean tree passes.

SR-016.justification: Signal, timeout and error exits count as absent even with ok=1 printed, and derive_tier never rises without every capability; the default-seccomp container measured T2 with userns EPERM.

SR-017.evidence: tests/kernel_facts/src/bin/kf-probe/macos.rs::ext_parent (token written to the child's stdin, never in argv or emit) and ::ext_child (reads stdin)
SR-017.justification: The token goes only through the stdin pipe, the argv carries the scratch path and order only, and no emit call includes it; the granted directories are inside a 0700 scratch.
